e.title: Vault Health MCP
e.summary: 知识库结构体检：死链/orphan/缺 frontmatter，带自动修复
e.body:
vault-health-mcp 是知识库结构健康检查 MCP：检测 broken links、orphans、缺失 frontmatter 并自动修复。对本站：可在 CI 中校验所有 slug 都解析到真实词条，防止词条手动维护引入死链；配合 [[obsidian]] 笔记库工作流使用。

## 同类工具
[[enquiry-consent-mcp]]、[[eshm20-mcp]]、[[mcp-cmf-chile]]
e.verified_note: 源码核实：README 能力确认，未实测
e.summary_en: Vault structural health checks: broken links/orphans/missing frontmatter with auto-repair
e.summary_hk: 知識庫結構體檢：死鏈/orphan/缺 frontmatter，帶自動修復
e.body_en:
vault-health-mcp is a vault structural health-check MCP: detects broken links, orphans and missing frontmatter and can auto-repair them. For this site: a CI step could validate that every slug resolves to a real entry, keeping the hand-maintained entries free of dead links; pairs with the [[obsidian]] vault workflow.

## Similar tools
[[enquiry-consent-mcp]]、[[eshm20-mcp]]、[[mcp-cmf-chile]]
e.body_hk:
vault-health-mcp 是知識庫結構健康檢查 MCP：檢測 broken links、orphans、缺失 frontmatter 並自動修復。對本站：可在 CI 中校驗所有 slug 都解析到真實詞條，防止詞條手動維護引入死鏈；配合 [[obsidian]] 筆記庫工作流使用。

## 同類工具
